title: Find why named-root closing jobs end in terminal failure (236 on Central)
outcome: The causes of terminal closing-job failures are known and classified (product, test/runner, environment), and each product cause has its own filed item.
acceptance: Using only the diagnostics routes and the source, with no live store reads, the terminal closing-job failures retained on Central are grouped by failure reason, with counts.
Each group is classified as product defect, test/runner or environment, with evidence cited from the code path that produces it.
Every product-defect group has its own filed item with provenance, or a recorded reason why none is needed.
